params.name: expand
params.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

params.name: name
params.description: A name for the secret that's unique within the scope.

params.name: scope
params.description: Specifies the scoping of the secret. Requests originating from UI extensions can only access account-scoped secrets or secrets scoped to their own user.

items.docs: Finds a secret in the secret store by name and scope.
